thread:
Leah (CSM): Heads-up — AuroraEdge (enterprise) wants to onboard a custom 13B QA model tuned on internal docs. They flagged PHI in the corpus and want an on-prem option + HSM key wrap. They also asked about SLAs/renewal exposure if latency isn't met. Can we triage?
Devon (Solutions Eng): Sounds doable but need details: dataset size, average doc length, expected QPS, and if they need embeddings pinned.
Leah (CSM): Copying the customer note: '~120k docs (avg 600 tokens), peak infer QPS ~45, 99th pct latency target 250ms, must not leave VPC, keys in HSM. Looking for dedicated pool and can commit 12mo.'
Aisha (Safety): PHI presence means we need a safety/evals plan and de-id gating. Recommend a quick risk matrix: data sensitivity, retrieval leakage tests, hallucination regression set. I can draft evals.
Ravi (Platform Eng): On-prem + HSM is a private deployment ask. We need to confirm infra: do they want full on-prem runtime or VPC-hosted private? On-prem will add ops lead time. Also dedicated GPU pool sizing for 13B at 45 QPS — we should ballpark cost.
Tess (Account Exec): They're mid-renewal (6 months) and have legal constraints — if we don't hit latency they'll consider alternate vendors. This is a revenue-risk flag. Prioritize this.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Quick config sketch for dedicated private run (proto):
```
model: auroraedge-13b-custom
deployment: private-dedicated
gpus: 8xA100
batching: dynamic, max_batch=64
kv_cache: enabled
kms: hsm-wrap
latency_slo: p99<=250ms
```
Devon (Solutions Eng): If they need sub-250ms p99 at 45 QPS we'll need aggressive batching + warm KV cache and proposer autoscale/burst. Also check quantization compatibility with customer's weights.
Aisha (Safety): For evals I'll need 1) a PHI test set (we can anonymize) 2) 200 targeted prompts for hallucination/regression 3) retrieval leakage harness. I'll create a checklist and a small eval harness pipeline.
Ravi (Platform Eng): I'll create a private-deploy checklist ticket and an infra estimate. @onboard-bot can you open a ticket for 'auroraedge-private-13b' and link docs?
onboard-bot: Ticket #CS-81234 created: auroraedge-private-13b (assignee: Ravi). Details: https://redwood.example/tickets/CS-81234 :white_check_mark:
Leah (CSM): Thanks — I'll request the customer share the sample PHI test set and confirm whether they can accept token-level logging disabled. Any blockers from legal/security?
Tess (Account Exec): Legal asked for KMS/HSM attestation + SOC2 addendum. I'll loop in legal after we have the infra plan.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Action items: 1) Ravi: infra ticket + cost estimate 2) Aisha: safety eval plan 3) Leah: request PHI test set + confirm logging policy with customer 4) Tess: legal/KMS attestation ask.
Aisha (Safety): I'll post the eval checklist here by EOD and include suggested metrics: exact-match, F1 for span answers, hallucination rate, and retrieval-leakage score.
Leah (CSM): Perfect. I'll set a customer call for Friday to align. :calendar:
Tess (Account Exec): Noted — putting renewal-risk flag on the account. If we can promise a canary SLA for p99 within 6 weeks that should stabilize renewal.
Ravi (Platform Eng): FYI some infra constraints: on-prem deployments require network egress rules and an ops-runbook. I'll attach draft runbook to ticket.
Leah (CSM): Great — will update AuroraEdge and book the eng sync. :thumbsup:
_meta_note: This thread is a single Slack conversation recording a CSM-led intake for a customer's private onboarding request. Messages are short and realistic with @mentions, bot response, a config code block, and actionable next steps. No title field included per agents.md.
